rationale: Both Saori and Kazumasa are materials science researchers at Resonac with overlapping focus on semiconductor and materials development. While Kazumasa brings additional depth from his prior experience at Sony, they share the same technical domain and company context, making them well-positioned to exchange insights on current research directions and industry applications.
intro_message: Saori Miura, meet Kazumasa Marumo — fellow materials science researchers at Resonac who can compare notes on semiconductor and materials development work.
